correctness.rationale: For hub value s and blade sum w_j, every blade vertex label a satisfies s+w_j-a>=1; the hub requires sum_j w_j>=1. Case s=-1 forces each blade w_j>=3; s=1 forces >=2; s=2 forces >=0, and for odd t forces >=1 by parity and a label-2 case. The even optimum has exactly one weight-1 blade; the odd optimum all weight-1 blades. Explicit labelings achieve bounds and all minima require s=2. Solving a+b+d=t and -a+b+2d=1 gives the H_t multinomial count; weight-zero blades have C(t,t/2) patterns. Independently enumerated all 3^(1+mt) original vertex assignments for (2,3),(2,4),(3,3): optimum (4,9),(3,144),(5,27), hub 2 always, agreeing with formula. Universal proof uses exact blade inequalities, not finite enumeration.
residual_risks: Excluded t=2 is not part of the theorem; no claims for unequal blade orders.
